headline: Good morning — Project Intake worked the night shift.
subtitle: Mission Control is live. One button runs your whole pipeline.

whats_new.detail: Profile health tracker, Run Full Pipeline, and quick-open export folders — right under the pipeline cards.

whats_new.detail: Import I/O → Scaffold → Spatial (when layout files exist) in sequence with a live progress stepper.

whats_new.detail: Excel, L5X, overlay, and section drops now show the real filename + full path so you know exactly what landed.

whats_new.title: Spatial Layout tab
whats_new.detail: Second tab on Project Intake — overlay + section PNGs → zone map + OCR labels → spatial_layout.json.

whats_new.title: Keyboard shortcuts
whats_new.detail: Ctrl+1 I/O tab · Ctrl+2 Spatial · Ctrl+Shift+R Run Full Pipeline · Ctrl+B Morning Brief · F1 shortcuts help

quick_start: Select or create an intake profile (SITE_MCP05, MGE9_MCP05, etc.)
Drop PLC.xls + your .L5X — verify filenames in the slots
Click Run Full Pipeline in Mission Control
Spatial tab: drop overlay + sections when drawings are ready
